title: 🌻 GOLDEN SUNFLOWERS — JEPA + Universal Transformer + PhiNTA on a φ-physics substrate
author: gHashTag

data.description: Universal Transformer-style weight-shared depth loops over a configurable sub-stack.
Weight-shared recurrent application of a sub-stack in the Universal Transformer component.
Trainable LoRA adapter used in PhiNTA, placed pre-head or per-block.
PhiNTA adapter on random linear maps with frozen basis plus trainable LoRA, optionally per-block.
JEPA auxiliary loss using a linear-representation cosine-similarity formulation over hidden-state spans.
φ-LR multiplicative override exposing α_φ = φ^-3 / 2 as a scale on Muon matrix learning rate.

novel_contributions: Combines JEPA auxiliary loss, Universal Transformer depth recurrence, and PhiNTA in one train_gpt.py.
Uses env-var gating so all new features are no-ops by default and preserve baseline byte-equivalence.
Introduces a frozen 1/φ-OrthoInit basis with trainable LoRA for PhiNTA.
Adds a JEPA linear-representation loss over hidden-state spans.
Exposes a φ-derived learning-rate scale constant α_φ = φ^-3 / 2.
Includes CPU-only smoke verification, baseline equivalence checks, and Coq-checked φ-physics claims.
